1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in criminal history of the applicant total 04 criminal cases has been registered, details of which is as under:-
(i) Case Crime No.925 of 2021 under Sections 323, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 419, 420,
504, 506 I.P.C. & U/s 447 of Company Act, Police Station- Kotwali Nagar, District- Barabanki.

(iii)Case Crime No.157 of 2022 under Section 406 I.P.C., Police Station- Vibhuti Khand, District- Lucknow.

(iv)Case Crime No.85 of 2021 under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 147, 352, 323, 504,

3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that furnishing of two sureties in all 04 different cases is almost impracticable as the applicant is facing hardship and he will not be able to arrange 08 sureties to get bail.
4. It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in similar circumstances, namely,

in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Crl.)
No.8914-8915/2018) the Hon'ble Apex Court vide order dated 29.10.2018 has permitted the petitioner/applicant to submit personal bonds and two sureties of heavy amount to hold good in all the cases.
